title: QueryRequestBody
description: The request body for download endpoints.

parameters.description: Filters to apply. Pass `[]` if the report has no required filters.

QueryFilterParameter.description: A filter value to include when downloading report data.

type.description: Use `"category"` for text filters. Also `"date/range"` and `"number/="`.

target.description: Points to the filter: `["variable", ["template-tag", "filter_name"]]` where `filter_name` matches the `name` field in the report's filters.
